Name: Tortilla Trees
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Saplings can be bought from Krobus.
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33203]Book Collecting[/url] installed, this mod adds a tortilla book for you to collect.
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18928]Leaf Collecting[/url] installed, this mod adds a tortilla leaf for you to collect.
i18n-compatible.

Downloads.Description: You can now get a tortilla book if you have Book Collecting installed because why not

Manifest.Description: And they say tortillas don't grow on trees...
